user.title: Configure INIM Prime
user.description: Choose which backend(s) to use for this panel.

serial_number.title: Panel Serial Number
serial_number.description: PrimeLAN cannot retrieve the panel's serial number automatically. Enter it manually.

connection.title: Connect to your panel
connection.description: Enter connection details for your INIM Prime alarm panel.

native.name: Native
native.description: Settings for the Native protocol connection.

data_description.port: TCP port the panel's Native protocol listens on.
data_description.use_outer_frame: Enable only if your panel requires the outer communication frame.
data_description.password: Native protocol password. Leave at the default unless you've changed it on the panel.
data_description.use_custom_pin: Enable to authenticate with a specific installer/user PIN instead of the default.
data_description.pin: PIN code used to authenticate with the panel.

primelan.name: PrimeLAN
primelan.description: Settings for the PrimeLAN API connection.

data_description.use_https: Use HTTPS instead of HTTP to reach the PrimeLAN gateway.
data_description.api_key: API key used to authenticate with the PrimeLAN gateway.

data_description.panel_log_events_fetch_limit:
Number of log events fetched per scan when new logs are detected. Default is recommended.
The integration will automatically fetch more if needed.

scan_intervals.name: Scan intervals
scan_intervals.description: Controls how often Home Assistant sends API requests to the panel (lower values increase traffic). For details on which entities each interval affects, see the integration README.

data_description.zones: How often Home Assistant sends API requests to fetch zone status.
data_description.partitions: How often Home Assistant sends API requests to fetch partition status.
data_description.gsm: How often Home Assistant sends API requests to fetch GSM status.
data_description.system_faults: How often Home Assistant sends API requests to fetch system faults.
data_description.panel_log_events: How often Home Assistant sends API requests to fetch new panel log events.

scan_intervals.name: Scan intervals
scan_intervals.description:
Controls how often Home Assistant sends API requests to the panel (lower values increase traffic). For details on which entities each interval affects, see the integration README.
Note: the Native backend supports much lower intervals than PrimeLAN for Zones and Partitions. If you've just added or removed Native, the defaults below have been adjusted accordingly.
